description: Isolated Wi-Fi SDIO device-tree qualification variants (pre-qualification mission Phase A4, 2026-07-31). Applied via scripts/build/wifi-sdio-variant.sh, scoped strictly to the &msc1 (Wi-Fi) node. See docs/NEBULAOS_CAMERA_USB_RT_SOURCE_ANALYSIS.md sec 18.6-7/18.18 for the full source-grounded rationale.
held_constant_across_all_variants: sd-uhs-sdr104 (left as-is; confirmed inert given the fixed 3.3V-only vmmc-supply regulator, not touched by this A/B)
the stable per-device Wi-Fi MAC mechanism (Phase A3, entirely userspace, unaffected by any DT variant)
country/regulatory (ccode=CN unchanged per this mission's fixed decisions)

W0.description: Baseline - msc1 unchanged from its current, real, git-committed state.
W0.expected_kernel_behavior: SDIO IRQ handling continues polling (10ms adaptive ceiling, generic MMC core default without cap-sdio-irq). SDIO high-speed mode negotiation is never attempted (cap-mmc-highspeed is not consulted for an SDIO card by mmc_sdio_switch_hs()).

W1.expected_kernel_behavior: Generic MMC core sets MMC_CAP_SDIO_IRQ; the sdhci core's already-present enable_sdio_irq/ack_sdio_irq ops (unconditionally wired by sdhci_alloc_host(), never overridden by sdhci-ingenic.c) become live - SDIO in-band IRQ replaces polling, if electrically supported on this board (unconfirmed from source alone).

W2.expected_kernel_behavior: mmc_sdio_switch_hs()'s MMC_CAP_SD_HIGHSPEED check is now satisfied - SDIO high-speed mode negotiation is attempted for the Wi-Fi chip for the first time, if the CYW43438 itself supports it at the negotiated voltage (unconfirmed from source alone).

W3.expected_kernel_behavior: Both W1 and W2 effects combined.
W3.recommendation_source: docs/NEBULAOS_CAMERA_USB_RT_SOURCE_ANALYSIS.md's own mission text: only test after W1 and W2 independently pass (Phase B5 ordering: W0, W1, W2, then W3)

static_verification_performed.method: sed range-extraction of the &msc1 node after each variant application, host-side, no build required
confirmed: each variant's msc1 node contains exactly its intended property set, no more, no less

msc0 (the real eMMC boot storage)'s own verbatim-identical cap-mmc-highspeed; line is never modified by any variant, confirmed via a direct sed range-extraction of &msc0 after applying all four variants in sequence
the kernel checkout returns to a byte-identical, git-clean baseline after applying W0 (verified via `git status --porcelain` reporting empty)
not_yet_performed: decompiled DTB inspection of an actual built kernel image per variant (requires a real kernel build - deferred to Phase A11)
DTB SHA-256 / kernel config SHA-256 recording per variant (deferred to Phase A11's build pass)
hardware validation of any kind (deferred to Phase B5, Mode B, after explicit user confirmation the printer is available)

hardware_test_note: Do not proceed to W3 until W1 and W2 have independently passed their own full regression pass, per the mission's own explicit ordering requirement.
